question: In an equilateral triangle ABC, P is the centroid of this triangle. Side of ΔABC is 16√3 cm. What is the distance of point P from side BC?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In an **equilateral triangle**, the **centroid** is the same as the **incenter**.

The distance from the **centroid** to any side is the **inradius (r)** of the triangle.

Shortcut formula: Inradius (r) = side ÷ (2√3)

⇒ Distance = (16√3) ÷ (2√3)

⇒ Distance = 16 ÷ 2 = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side of **equilateral triangle ABC** (a) = 16√3 cm.

Point **P** is the **centroid**.

**Formula Used:**

Height (h) of equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 2) × side

Centroid divides the median in the ratio 2 : 1 from the vertex.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8bf4033cc814d32087adddac4337be24a337b831ba12ea2556dacd3d2773378.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Height (AD) = (√3 ÷ 2) × 16√3

⇒ AD = (16 × 3) ÷ 2

⇒ AD = 24 cm

⇒ The **centroid (P)** divides **median AD** in ratio **AP : PD = 2 : 1**.

⇒ Distance of P from side BC = PD

⇒ PD = (1 ÷ (2 + 1)) × AD

⇒ PD = (1 ÷ 3) × 24

⇒ PD = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equilateral Triangle Centroid

In an equilateral triangle, the centroid, orthocenter, circumcenter, and incenter all lie at the same point.

Inradius and Circumradius

For an equilateral triangle with side a, Inradius (r) = a / (2√3) and Circumradius (R) = a / √3. Note that R = 2r.

Median Property

The centroid divides each median into two segments with lengths in the ratio 2 : 1 from the vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side.</p
